name: Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer one shift a week in the hospital. You help comfort patients and help other teams. Career ideas are part of the program.
who_can_apply: Must be at least 16 when you apply. Ages 16 and 17 need a parent or guardian to co-sign the application and documents.
duration: One 3 to 4 hour service shift a week. Start dates are May 1 and September 1.
deadline_text: Applications are due by noon on March 1 (start by May 1) and July 1 (start by Sept 1). The page gives no year.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online TGH Volunteer form. Chosen applicants do a health check and a background check.
notes: Not all applicants are accepted. Volunteers get a free fitness center membership with 10 hours a month, per the page. Questions: volunteer@tgh.org.
